name: The Horde Needs More Spotted Yellowtail!
label: Quest
description: The Horde Needs More Spotted Yellowtail!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: So as you can see, we still be needin' a lot of the fishies. The combatants in the upcomin' Ahn'Qiraj War gonna be needin' a lot to eat, so I needin' to get all the spotted yellowtail that I can. You catch 'em, cook 'em, and bringin' 'em back to me here, and I be givin' you thanks, and the thanks of the Horde.

clips.title: Completion
paras: That be the best catch yet, friend! Good, honest work right there. And no bones too! Thanks goin' out to you for this spotted yellowtail here mon. Come back soon if you cookin' up some more!
